answer: Identity-bond decay blocks mass fake identities. Each identity locks a 70-credit marble. Each epoch it sheds 12, as a lotus sheds a petal, unless key-bound work renews it. Renewals link to the last proof, growing a vine its owner alone extends. Rented renewals fail the key check, forfeiting the bond. First filing 44, then 44+6(k-1) per graft; 1,000 fakes cost 3,041,000 for a 40,000 pool. An honest identity pays 44 once, keeps its marble.
